📢 WE ARE HIRING! 📢

St. Xavier’s Higher Secondary School, Mapusa, Bardez-Goa is inviting applications for several posts on a REGULAR BASIS! 🏫✨

Open Positions:

Teacher Grade-I in Hindi– M.A. (Hindi) & B.Ed (04 Posts)

Teacher Grade-I in Konkani – M.A. (Konkani) & B.Ed (01 Post)

Teacher Grade-I in English – M.A. (English) & B.Ed (02 Posts)

Teacher Grade-I in Biology – M.Sc. with Botany/Zoology/Life Sciences/etc. & B.Ed (02 Posts)

Teacher Grade-I in Physics– M.Sc. (Physics) & B.Ed (02 Posts)

Physical Education Teacher – Post Graduate + B.P.Ed OR Graduate + M.P.Ed (01 Post)

M.T.S. – SSC Pass (01 Post)

Eligibility Criteria:

* Age limit: Below 45 years

* Required: Valid Employment Exchange Registration, Residence Certificate, and supporting testimonials

📩 How to Apply:
Send your application with testimonials to The Manager, St. Xavier's Higher Secondary School, Mapusa, Goa within 10 days. Don't forget to include your email ID and contact number on your resume!
